findings.quote: tomten blev upplag för vägkassens grus
findings.note: class 1 (wrong derivation/inflection): the intended sense is the road-maintenance fund, i.e. 'kassa' (en kassa, definite 'kassan', genitive 'kassans'). 'vägkassens' presupposes a base noun *'vägkasse' (kasse = carrier bag/net), which yields 'the road bag's gravel'. Swedish -a feminines never take -en in edited prose (cf. sjukkassan, arbetslöshetskassan, Försäkringskassan); the authentic HP corpus shows only -kassan/-kassans for fund words and -kassen only for 'plastkassen'. Native alternative: 'upplag för vägkassans grus'.

findings.quote: ber om en timme i en gymnastiksal en tisdagkväll
findings.note: class 1 (compound joint / missing foge-s): edited sakprosa writes “tisdagskväll” with the linking -s (måndagskväll, fredagskväll); the s-less compound belongs to colloquial or transcribed speech. The unit contradicts itself — the title reads “Tisdagskvällar i Vässlinges gymnastiksalar” with the -s. Not lethal because the s-less form does occur in informal native writing (one instance of “fredagkväll” in the authentic HP corpus, inside colloquial first-person narration), but a copy editor of this register fixes it. Native alternative: “en tisdagskväll”.
